Game Overview

Nikosan Quest 2 puts players into a adventure experience centered on guide brave heroine Nikosan in a vibrant animated world, mastering double jumps and strategic maneuvers to gather golden cubes. As challenges intensify, your timing and precision become key in this exhilarating journey through perilous heavens, where every move counts toward conquering the ultimate quest.
